layout.title: Make your chat space your own
layout.description: Build your own chat page by arranging messages, the composer and tools, then writing styles for each component. Preview before applying.
layout.importHint: Choose a layout JSON file or paste one generated by AI (up to 64 KiB). Importing opens a preview before applying.
layout.jsonPlaceholder: Paste the complete layout JSON here
layout.presetFocusHint: Tuck away panels and focus on messages
layout.presetWorkbenchHint: Context on the left, compact reading
layout.name: Layout name
layout.saveHint: Save for later; saving with the same name updates that template. Your chat changes only after applying.
layout.localHint: Layouts are saved on this device. Export and import to reuse them elsewhere. Composer shortcuts remain separately customizable.
layout.applied: Applied. Your chats now use this layout.
layout.saved: Template saved. Choose Apply layout to use it in your chats.
layout.restored: Default layout loaded for preview. Choose Apply layout to use it. Your saved templates are still available.
layout.imported: Layout imported for preview. Choose Apply layout when ready.
layout.deleted: Template deleted. Your current chat layout is unchanged.
layout.deleteHint: Remove “{name}” from My templates. Your current chat layout will stay the same.
layout.errorTooLarge: This layout is too large. Use a JSON file no larger than 64 KiB.
layout.errorVersion: This layout version is not supported. Import a version 1 or 2 template.
layout.errorSavedLimit: You can save up to 20 templates. Update an existing name or remove one first.
layout.errorName: Use a layout name of 1–80 characters, without line breaks or control characters.
layout.errorJson: This is not valid JSON. Paste only the layout content, without Markdown code fences.
layout.errorFields: A layout field is invalid or incomplete: {field}. Export an existing template as a reference.
layout.errorRead: Could not process the layout file. Choose the file again and retry.
layout.storageError: This device cannot save layouts. Changes may be lost after restarting; export your template to keep a copy.
layout.mobileHint: On mobile, navigation and context open in drawers to leave room for messages.
layout.previewAssistant: Sure. Start with the most important task, then make time for the rest.
layout.previewComposer: What would you like to do?
layout.previewHint: Layout illustration; no messages are sent. The workspace adapts when space is limited.
canvas.alreadyAdded: Already on canvas; move it to rearrange
canvas.addHint: Click to add into the selected container, or drag onto the canvas. Selecting a component adds to its parent container.
canvas.requiredHint: The root, messages, and composer are required. Move required components elsewhere before removing their container.
canvas.cssHint: Write color, size, typography, spacing, Flex or Grid declarations. Theme variables are supported; selectors, scripts and external resources are not.
canvas.cssError: This style is invalid and has not been applied. Check the declarations and properties, or undo the edit.
canvas.previewHint: Select a component, then drag it into a container or before or after another component. Preview uses sample content and sends no messages.
canvas.operationError: This change could not be made. Check for duplicate chat components, moving a container into itself, or removing messages or the composer.
canvas.editHint: Add, nest and arrange components. Select one to edit its styles; move buttons work on mobile too.
canvas.invalidStyles: Styles for {count} components are invalid. Fix them before saving or applying.
layout.presetStudioHint: Clear regions, generous spacing and an integrated composer
library.empty: No saved templates yet. Save one after editing.
library.renameHint: Only the template name changes. Unsaved edits are preserved.
library.saveAsHint: Create a separate copy. Duplicate names get a suffix; existing templates are preserved.
library.saved: Saved “{name}”. Your current chat layout is unchanged.
library.renamed: Template renamed. Your edits have been preserved.
library.imported: “{name}” was added to My templates and opened for preview.
library.errorDuplicateName: A template with that name already exists. Choose another name.
library.errorNotFound: This template no longer exists. Choose another template.
library.unsavedHint: Switching replaces the current draft. You can keep editing and save your changes or a new copy first.
transfer.importHint: Choose or paste layout JSON (up to 64 KiB). Importing saves it to My templates for preview and preserves existing templates with the same name.
transfer.importApplyHint: Choose or paste layout JSON (up to 64 KiB). Importing saves and applies the layout, preserving existing templates with the same name.
transfer.exportHint: Download the JSON file, or copy the content below to import on another device.
transfer.copyError: Clipboard access failed. The JSON is selected for you to copy manually.
transfer.downloadRequested: Download requested. If it does not start, copy the JSON instead.
transfer.downloadError: Download failed. Copy the JSON below and save it instead.
switcher.label: Chat layout
switcher.scope: Applies to all chats on this device
